intent.description: Use when Kang requests his presentation quality standard, several full-size visual or narrative directions before a major deck, evidence-aware presentation design, or a high-quality review of a PPT/PPTX. This Skill governs judgment and quality, then delegates PPTX implementation to the installed Presentations Skill. Exclude ordinary PPT creation without the Kang standard, single-word edits, read-only slide questions, format conversion, native Feishu/Google Slides operations, frontend design, and image-only generation.
intent.job_to_be_done: Apply Kang's proportional presentation-design and acceptance standard to major creation, redesign, and quality-review work while delegating PPTX implementation to Presentations.
exclusions: ordinary PPT work without the Kang standard

should_trigger: 按 Kang 的 PPT 标准给这个客户方案先出三套完整视觉方向
用 kang-ppt-skill 重做这份项目汇报的叙事和视觉
检查这份客户提案的证据、字号、图片和逐页交付质量
按我的演示标准制作一份有来源的 AI 教学 PPT
这个 PPT 审美要求高，先给我不同叙事和版式方向
should_not_trigger: 帮我正常制作一份三页 PPT
把第 4 页的错别字改掉
读取这个 PPT 第三页的表格数据
在飞书幻灯片新建一页
把网页的按钮做得更好看
生成一张建筑室内效果图
near_neighbor: 按照现有公司模板替换本月数字，布局不要变
帮我写一份客户提案文案，不需要 PPT

activation.major_or_high_aesthetic: apply Kang's standard and preview directions unless the user overrides
activation.selective_or_template_work: apply only when explicitly requested; keep scope direct

execution.visual_review: individual full-size rendered slides plus technical checks

permissions.presentation_write: delegate to Presentations within approved scope

degradation.inaccessible_reference: record missing evidence and use inspected local resources or explicitly original exploration
degradation.unavailable_presentations_runtime: stop PPTX authoring and report the blocker

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
